description: Product Structure Management — BOM Component and Routing Operations

transactions.name: AddComponent
transactions.description: Add a BOM line (component + quantity + operation) to a product structure

transactions.name: AddOperation
transactions.description: Add a new routing step to a product structure

transactions.name: CopyComponent
transactions.description: Copy an existing BOM component to a new sequence, optionally overriding quantity and effectivity. Source identified by CSEQ/CFDT; destination by MSEQ/FDAT.

transactions.name: CopyOperation
transactions.description: Copy an existing routing operation to a new operation number, optionally overriding work centre and times. Source identified by COPN/CFDT; destination by OPNO/FDAT.

transactions.name: Delete
transactions.description: Delete a product structure component (by MSEQ) or operation (by OPNO)

transactions.name: GetComponent
transactions.description: Retrieve a single BOM component by key (FACI/PRNO/STRT/MSEQ/FDAT). Returns full component detail including item type, status, quantities, and effectivity.

transactions.name: GetOperation
transactions.description: Retrieve a single routing operation by key (FACI/PRNO/STRT/OPNO/FDAT). Returns full operation detail including work centre, times, and planning parameters.

transactions.name: LstComponent
transactions.description: List BOM components for a product structure. Position with MSEQ for range reads; omit MSEQ to start from the beginning of the structure. Returns one record per call; loop on same session until OK status.

transactions.name: LstOperation
transactions.description: List all routing operations for a product structure. Call without OPNO and FDAT to use the 4-field key and return all ops from the start (source-verified 2026-05-08).

transactions.name: UpdateComponent
transactions.description: Modify an existing BOM component on a product structure. Key fields: FACI/PRNO/STRT/MSEQ/OPNO/FDAT. Only supplied fields are updated. Field positions MiTest-verified 2026-08-11.

fields.name: TDAT
fields.description: To date (YYYYMMDD) — 99999999 = active; ECN effective date = close line

transactions.name: UpdateOperation
transactions.description: Modify a routing operation on a product structure
